transitions.summary: Patient nesting and care sustain a harmonious family in which siblings mature well, find fitting places, and contribute to one another’s contentment.
Two minds pull in contrary directions and repeatedly reopen the same dispute, consuming the day without producing either movement or agreement.
Something precious is exchanged for what cannot justify its cost; concealment then deepens the error, turning poor judgment into escalating loss.
Assistance arrives from both sides while resources gather steadily, creating a store of value that grows without corresponding depletion.
Malicious alliance corrupts judgment at the center, framing principled people and scattering a lineage through death, exile, and the destruction of trust.
Related lives intertwine at their roots and gather by affinity, finding security in mutual reliance without abandoning their common place of origin.
Repeated rain and dense cloud withhold the sun for too long, turning potentially nourishing weather into a sustained atmosphere of heaviness.
Crude strength confronts conditions beyond its command; ridicule and insecurity reveal that wealth alone cannot protect a position opposed by the larger order.
At a turbulent shore, the prince moves slowly and alone without a clear destination, mirroring uncertainty in the winding depth beside him.
Many kinds of game are brought together and the catch exceeds what remains at pasture, pleasing authority through concentrated abundance.
Interpreters stationed at the boundary bridge separation and resolve uncertainty, allowing all parties to share the fortunate result.
The bird reaches for grain but a predator suddenly drives it away, replacing expected nourishment with breathless fear and an empty outcome.
Companions traveling the same road each lose what they carried, while light itself seems to disappear; without visibility, recovery remains impossible.
A benefit descending from above establishes steady prosperity and removes immediate danger, leaving the situation calm, open, and consistently supported.
A wronged exile builds an alliance, returns with overwhelming retaliation, and converts satisfied vengeance into public authority, though the history behind the image remains morally costly.
Trouble arrives together with an impassable mountain barrier, making ordinary means ineffective and leaving the household divided across the blocked road.
Relentless rain raises the sea into charging waves; amid unstable waters, only the higher ground offers a dependable refuge.
Snakes enter shelter according to autumn’s rhythm while a royal wife returns alone to her natal state, joining necessary retreat with separation.
Removing one troublesome growth introduces a more damaging one, and escape from one confined place leads into another; attempted correction compounds the difficulty.
A traveler enters water deeper than expected and is soaked, but timely practical help arrives before discomfort develops into disaster.
A swift journey across a storied landscape unexpectedly meets a culture hero and still completes with a return to familiar ground.
A summons to cultivate plentiful land aligns effort with the agricultural season, producing abundance and a period of public rest.
The reclusive life remains steady as the heavenly lights, finding ease outside ordinary entanglement and avoiding the sorrows attached to public striving.
An extraordinary mare covers immense distance along an even road, linking exceptional capacity with a journey free from obstruction or anxiety.
Elders rejoice as descendants assemble around them, and family continuity becomes the foundation for growing prosperity, honor, and shared blessing.
A neighbor is disregarded in pursuit of an idealized beauty, while contemptuous appearance-based judgment exposes the vanity within the preference.
Birdsong, dance, and shared drink announce expanding joy, while seals and royal emblems portray recognition and blessing arriving together.
When radiance, nourishment, and animating spirit all withdraw, the remaining condition is one of profound obscurity without a sustaining center.
Affection and marriage plans become tied to hopes of wealth, but the anticipated gain reverses into impoverishment when relationship is treated as acquisition.
Harness, horses, and wheels cease to function as one system, so rapid motion produces neither arrival nor safety and instead exposes the travelers to harm.
A prolonged wilderness assignment offers neither return nor meaningful engagement, leaving the wanderer’s attention fixed on the distant bond of home.
Backward flight and an injurious meal mark an undertaking out of alignment; departing from sound pattern prevents the work from succeeding.
A solitary bird calls and is joined by its mate, transforming the bitterness of isolation into shelter, nourishment, and shared enjoyment.
Clear intelligence neither lingers where perception is obscured nor enters avoidable danger, preserving an enduring atmosphere of ease and joy.
Two figures remain calm on separate mountains and can see one another clearly, yet distance prevents their regard from becoming an actual meeting.
A household enjoys peace at the mountain’s foot until the larger structure collapses overnight, destroying the vessels that sustained ordinary life.
Long attendance before authority yields neither response nor needed rain; refusal at the center hardens into cruelty and forfeits the people’s trust.
Advice is ignored while a questionable bargain proceeds; the image of grasping a tiger warns that once danger is held, needless provocation magnifies it.
Two immense creatures battle at the margins as ruler and minister cease communicating, allowing external struggle to drive legitimate authority into exile.
The achievements of exemplary rulers animate even the natural world, while distant peoples freely gather around governance they recognize as humane.
Celestial and mythic favor bring rank, resources, and an honored dwelling, presenting recognition as a stable condition of protected dignity.
Wind drives flame through dry growth, combining several destructive forces at once and extending the injury beyond the immediate landscape to the next generation.
Emotion and private calculation overwhelm sound judgment; the greedy pursuit of advantage then meets violent resistance and bodily danger.
When gain displaces ethical measure, even a broad illuminating sky cannot prevent public order from sinking into self-created disorder.
Exemplary rulers share drink, dance, and libation within abundant rites, linking cultivated celebration with social peace and the protection of the household.
An ape falls from a great height without lasting injury, retrieves a symbol of authority, and completes the disturbance by returning home.
Harvest and reward arrive without corresponding labor, but excess beyond merit cannot hold; vehicle, house, and office all give way.
Public talk multiplies around a path no one actually understands, yet inward steadiness remains sufficient for durable peace.
